adjudication.rationale: The diff in `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` removes `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` and all related `category_id` logic, so `-c/--category` is no longer accepted and posts can no longer be routed to a specified category via this CLI (breaking backward compatibility). It also changes import behavior from creating a post with a simple permalink raw (`PostCreator.new(... raw: "[[Permalink](...)]" ...)`) to fetching and embedding remote page content via `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`. However, the claim that this “alters dry_run output” is not verifiable from the diff because the remote fetch occurs only inside `if options[:dry_run].blank?` (i.e., not in dry-run).
